content: Damaskusot Saul
Saule hehono Malikor sahabi okkolor uwore zafai forat roiye edde hitarare zane mari felaibo domki diyat roiye. Saule ḍõr imamor heṛe giye,
edde hitattu Damaskus šohoror sinagog okkololla šeṛi saiye, zene Saule he fõtot giyede hendilla nari furuš zarare faibo, hitarare bandi Zeruzalem loi ani fare.
Hite baisa di Damaskusor hãsa hãsi fõissegoide šomot, asmanottu atikka ek fohoror šoṛak hitar sairo mikka foijje.
Hite meṛit fori giyegoi edde ek abaz fuinne, hodde,

content.text: "Saul, Saul, kiyolla tui ãr uwore zulum goror?"

content: Saule hodde, "Malik, tũi honnuwa?" Malike hodde,

content.text: "Ãi he Isa, zar uwore tui zulum goror.
Tui ehon uṛi šohoror butore za, tottu ki gora foribo hin tore heṛe howa oibo."

content: Ze manuš okkol Saulor fũwati giye hitara ammuwak oi tiyai roiye, hitara abaz fuinne kintu honokiyore no deke.
Bade Saul uṛi tiyaiye edde suk kuille, kintu hite suke deki no faijjil. Hetunot hitar fũwajja okkole hate dori dori hitare Damaskus šohorot loigiye.
Tin din foijjonto Saul anda oi aššil edde hána fani kissu no há.
Damaskusot Ananiyas name ekzon sahabi aššil. Malike hibare deha diyore hodde,
Hibaye hodde, "Malik, so ãi eṛe."
Toi Malike hibare hodde,

content.text: "Uzu name ze rasta ase tui he rastat za, heṛe Ehudar górot Saul hoi ekzon Tarsus šohoror manušore talaš gorgoi, kiyollahoile hite duwa gorer.
Ar hite ek deha faiyede heṛe dekedde, Ananiyas name ekzon manuš aiyore hitar uwore hat rakibo, toi hite abar suke dekibo."

content: Kintu Ananiyase hodde, "Malik, ãi bout kiyor mukottu ei manušwar babute fuinni, Zeruzalemot tũwar Paki manuš okkolor uwore ite hondilla zulum okkol goijje.
Ar ehon, hite ḍõr imamottu kemota loi õnor name ḍakede har mainšore bandi loizaibolla eṛe o aiššiye."
Kintu Ananiyasore Malike hodde,

content.text: "Tui za! Kiyollahoile Oihudi edde hitarar badša okkol edde Israili okkolor hãse ãr babute tobolig goribolla ite ãr basona goijja zontro.
Ãi hitare dehaiyum ãr namolla buli hitattu hoto duk šowa foribo."

content: Toi Ananiyas giye edde he górot góille, ar Saulor uwore hat rakiyore hodde, "Bái Saul, eṛe aibar fõtot tore ze deha dil he Isaye ãre defeṛaiye, zene tui suke dekibar šokti firai fos edde Pak Ruhuye furaiya os."
Hetunot Saulor sukottu õišor ḍoilla ekkan ki fori giyegoi, toi hite abar suke deki faijje. Tarfore hite uiṭṭe edde torikotor gusol loiye,
tarfore hite hána haiyore doromoro oiye. Saule hoto din Damaskus šohoror biššaši okkolor fũwati heṛe taikke.
Ar deri no gori hibaye sinagog okkolot tobolig gora šuru goijje, ze Isa oilde Allar Fut.

Beggune zara hibar hota funito, hitara tajjuf oi fusar gorito, Zeruzalemot zara Isar nam dori ḍakito hitarare zulum goittode, ite no ne ki? Ar eṛe o zara Isar nam dori ḍake hitarare bandi ḍõr imamor hãse loi zaibolla aiššede, ite no ne ki?
Saule kintu lagatar ḍõr ḍõr šokti faiye. Damaskusor Ihudi okkole zuwab dibolla fõt udda tui no fa, zẽtte hibaye Isa Moside forman diye.
Iyar bout din bade Ihudi okkole hibare mari felaibolla felain goijje.
Kintu Saule hitarar felainor hota zani faijje. Hibare mari felaibolla hitara šohoror geiṭ okkolot dine raite fahara diye.
Kintu ek raitta hibar šagirit okkole hibare ek ḍular butore gori loizai ḍebal far gorai diye.
Zeruzalemot Saul
Saul Zeruzalem ai bade sahabi okkol loi zug dito saiye, kintu beggune hibare ḍoraiye. Saul ze ekzon hãsa biššaši hiyan hitara biššaš gori no faijjil.

Kintu Barnabase hibare fũwati asab okkolor hãse loigiye edde Saule fõtot ki bafe Malikor deha fail edde ki bafe Malike Saul loi hota hoil, ar ki bafe Saule Damaskusot šahoš loi Isar nam tobolig goijje hin okkol hibaye hitarare zanaiye.
Tarfore oite Saul hitarar fũwati Zeruzalemot takito edde butore baire aša zawa goitto, ar kulasa bafe edde šahoš loi Malikor namot tobolig gorito.
Hibaye Girik baša hoiya Ihudi okkol loi hotabattara edde barabari goitto, kintu hitara hibare mari felaibolla kušiš goijje.
Torikotor báiyain okkole zehon ei hota fuinne, hibare Sizeriya šohorot loi giyegoi, toi hentu Tarsus šohorot faṭai diye.

He šomot Ehudiya, Galil edde Sameriya eleha okkolor zomat okkolot šanti aššil. He zomatgun gori uṭṭil, hiyanor zoriya Malikor mutallek ḍor edde Pak Ruhur tuwajjo loi solat zomator manuš okkol bari uṭṭil.
Fitoror keramot
Fitore hár zagat gurite gurite Ludda šohorot ze Allar bonda okkol aššil hitarar hãse aišše.
Heṛe Aneas name ekzon manušore dekkil, hite aššilde ãtur, ze ašṭo bosor mula bisanat fori roiye.
Fitore hitare dekiyore hodde: "Aneas, Isa Mosiye tore bala gorer. Uṭ, tor bisana tuli lo." Hite hehon uṛi tiyaiye.
Henot Ludda šohorot edde Šarun ḍeilot takitode hár manuš okkole Aneasore deki Malikor mikka fijje.
Zaffa šohorot Tabita name ek mayafuwa biššaši aššil, Girik bašat Dorka (mani Horini). Hibaye beši bala ham okkol edde gorib okkolore modot okkol gorito.
Kintu hẽtte hibattu beši ošuk oiyore bade mori giyegoi, ar manuš okkole hibare duwaiyore uworor uggwa kamerat rakkil.
Ludda aššilde Zaffa šohoror hãsa hãsi, toi sahabi okkole fuinne ze Fitor Luddat ase. Hitara duizon manušore hibar hãse defeṛaiye, hibare hitarar heṛe toratori aito foriyad goribolla hoi.

Toi Fitor hitarar fũwati giye. Hiba heṛe fõsi bade hibare uworor kamerat loigiye. Heṛe rari okkol beggune Fitorore berai doijje. Dorka basi taite hibaye ze kuruta edde oinno horsuwor silail hin okkolore hitara Fitorore deha šuru goijje edde handa šuru goijje.
Toi Fitore beggunore hentu niyolai diye edde ãṛu felai duwa goijje. Tarfore he mora maya fuwawar uzu firiyore hodde: "Tabita, uṭ! Henot hibaye suk kuille, ar Fitorore deki uṛi boišše."
Toi Fitore hat diyore hibare tuille. Tarfore biššaši edde rari okkolore ḍaikke edde hibare zinda dehaiye.
Ei hota Zaffa šohoror beggune zani faijje edde boute Malikor uwore biššaš ainne.
Fitor bout din mula Zaffa šohorot Simon name ekzon samorar ham goroyar górot taigilgoi.
